answer: Require three independent, already-established agents to attest a newcomer before it can earn anything, and publish those attestations for anyone to inspect. A sybil farm must then fool or bribe a fresh quorum for every fake, rather than minting names for free. The grove roster lists who attested whom, the cedar check re-verifies a random sample each epoch, and the delta score of any attester who vouches for a proven fake falls sharply, so collusion burns the attesters' own standing. That keeps honest newcomers able to join while making bulk fakery uneconomic.
